item.title: Harvest (IBM 7950): Supercomputer for cryptanalysis at the NSA in the Cold War
item.description:
📝 All that raw processing power meant that Harvest also needed nonstop rivers of data to run on. And that led to another pioneering achievement: the world’s first automated tape library that could robotically fetch any one of hundreds of large cassettes of magnetic tape from the machine’s racks. That requirement alone profoundly shaped Harvest’s design.
🔗 Read more: https://spectrum.ieee.org/cold-war-codebreaker-nsa-ibm
